definition: A named spacefaring setting context in the declared 2022 product's travel and adventure sections.
cultural_caution: A 5e product setting term, not a character node or an automatic equivalent of older-edition Spelljammer cosmology.

citations.locator: Contents, Chapter 2: Fire in Wildspace, creating a Wildspace system, and travel sections
supports: The official guide treats Wildspace as a dedicated adventure/travel context.

definition: Named planar/spacefaring contexts for traversal in the declared Fifth Edition product.
cultural_caution: Keep these 5e product terms distinct from prior-edition planar arrangements and do not make planes into character endpoints.

citations.locator: Contents, Chapter 2: The Astral Plane and Traversing the Astral Sea
supports: The official guide gives dedicated sections to the Astral Plane and Astral Sea.

definition: Named 5e spelljamming environmental/travel rule concepts in the Astral Adventurer's Guide.
cultural_caution: Edition-specific procedures, not general fantasy physics or universal setting facts outside this witness.

citations.locator: Contents, Chapter 2: Air Envelopes; Gravity Planes; Overlapping Gravity Planes
supports: The official guide presents these as spelljamming travel mechanics.

definition: The 5e product's named vehicle and enabling-item context for spacefaring travel.
cultural_caution: Ships and helms are vehicles/items, not characters; their rules and speed were subject to official errata.

citations.locator: Contents, Chapter 2: Spelljamming Ships; Spelljammer Vessels; Cost of a Spelljamming Helm
supports: The official guide contains dedicated ship and helm sections.

citations.locator: Astral Adventurer's Guide errata, Speed update
supports: Official errata revises a spelljamming-ship speed passage.

definition: Named 5e procedures for spelljamming conflict in the declared guide.
cultural_caution: Rules headings only; combat, crashing, and invasion themes may need table-specific content discussion and are not character attributes.

citations.locator: Contents, Chapter 2: Spelljammer Duels; Ship-to-Ship Combat; Crashing
supports: The official guide includes distinct conflict and crash procedures.
